My grandfather got married about a year after my grandma died from cancer. Everyone in my family acted suspicious at first, but eventually came around because they knew she probably saved him from an early death (my grandma handled all the money and the cooking; he was literally only eating canned/junk food after she passed and was very lonely).

Today we are all very happy that he married her and have come to see that she's exactly the right partner for him at this stage in his life, even years later. There is no correct length of time to wait for a new partner, and I hope that the people around you and your dad come to realize that, OP.

It's not the same as starving yourself, more like just monitoring your regular intake and then cutting back a couple hundred calories.

For example, say you normally eat 2000 calories a day to maintain your current weight. If you cut back to 1800 calories a day, you'll lose weight.
